aff.title: Gear & Supplements
aff.subtitle: Selected products that can add practical value to your training.
aff.disclosure: Affiliate links — I may receive a commission at no extra cost to you. Recommendations are based on usefulness, not commission.
aff.noProducts: No products are available for this region yet.
aff.reason.default: A practical option that may fit your current training context.
aff.reason.creatine: A well-studied performance supplement that may be useful for strength and high-intensity training.
aff.reason.protein: A convenient way to help meet protein needs when food alone is not practical.
aff.reason.dumbbells: Useful when you want more exercise options without needing a large training space.
aff.reason.bands: Portable resistance that works well when equipment and space are limited.
aff.reason.roller: A simple recovery and mobility tool; it should complement, not replace, sleep and sensible training load.
aff.reason.massage: A convenient self-massage tool that some athletes use for short-term comfort and recovery routines.
aff.reason.shoes: A training-specific option selected for stability and practical gym use.
aff.reason.book: Useful for athletes who want more context on programming, progression and training principles.
aff.regionNote: Choose your shopping region. The automatic choice uses browser language/time-zone signals and can be changed manually.
aff.chatPrefix: If a product is genuinely useful, you may mention it with [PRODUCT:product-id]. Never force a recommendation.
aff.commissionNote: Availability, price and commission terms can change.

os.title: Live training intelligence
os.noteHigh: Recent training stress is elevated. aOra can reduce lower-body volume or intensity when appropriate.
